user.title: Add Evides Tarieven
user.description: This integration scrapes the public Evides tariff page for the current drinking water tariffs (fixed annual charge, variable rate per m³ and water tax per m³). No account or API key is required.

init.title: Evides Tarieven settings
init.description: Tariffs usually change only once a year (on January 1st), so a daily check is more than enough.

pagina_gewijzigd.title: Evides tariff page has changed
pagina_gewijzigd.description:
The following tariffs could no longer be found on [the Evides tariff page]({url}): {ontbrekend}.

Evides most likely changed the layout of the page. The affected sensors are unavailable until the integration is updated. Check HACS for a new version, or report it via the issue tracker. This notice disappears automatically once all tariffs are found again.
